facts.claim: Matcher: '' or '.*' matches all tools (MCP included); 'mcp:*' matches all MCP tools; 'mcp:<regex>' matches MCP tool names; any other regex (unanchored RegExp) matches only non-MCP tools
Shell tool is launch-process (a 'shell' tool also exists in the input-details switch); MCP tool names are <tool>_<server>
Command hooks have no fail-closed switch: timeout (SIGTERM then SIGKILL after 5 s), spawn error, non-zero exit other than 2, and invalid JSON all continue (fail-open)
facts.source: npm:@augmentcode/auggie@0.36.0 package/augment.mjs xao, Bao catch {shouldContinue:!0}, wao non-blocking path, OIt returns null on parse failure

facts.claim: Deny: exit 2, or hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision 'deny', or top-level continue:false; each sets shouldContinue false and the tool call is blocked with a formatted message. Reason routing: permissionDecisionReason goes to the model on deny
facts.source: npm:@augmentcode/auggie@0.36.0 package/augment.mjs zIt and the runPreToolUseHook caller ('Tool execution blocked by hook')

facts.claim: permissionDecision allow and ask parse but are never read for control; the normal permission flow runs either way
facts.source: npm:@augmentcode/auggie@0.36.0 package/augment.mjs: permissionDecision only read in zIt, the aggregator and routeJsonFields

facts.claim: Input rewrite exists: hookSpecificOutput.updatedInput replaces the tool input (u=f.updatedInput)

facts.claim: toolPermissions script-policy is fail-closed: the script gets the JSON on stdin; exit 0 allows, any non-zero exit, a 30 s timeout (SIGKILL), a spawn error or a missing script file denies. stdout or stderr text becomes the denial detail
Hook env adds AUGMENT_PROJECT_DIR, AUGMENT_CONVERSATION_ID, AUGMENT_HOOK_EVENT, AUGMENT_TOOL_NAME (no secret filtering seen)
Nothing in a PreToolUse reply ends the whole run; continue:false only blocks this call
